next_step: Hold — monitor Private deployment roadmap; re-open when Redwood Private supports PrivateLink/VPC endpoints or if budget re-opens.
notes:
Summary: mid-stage procurement, strong fit for telemetry + support-agent use case but stalled due to private networking mismatch and internal changes.

Recent timeline (bulleted):
- 2025-09-12: Lead created after inbound trial usage (support-bot embedding heavy). AE Priya assigned.
- 2025-10-01: Intro call — product demo (hosted API) + high-level dedicated/private offering. Halcyon emphasized regulatory requirement: must not traverse public internet; wants PrivateLink or VPC endpoint into their AWS account.
- 2025-11-03: Technical deep dive (Fireflies ff_2025-11-03_0091) with infra and security. SE Marco demoed dedicated VPC options; customer asked explicit PrivateLink design.
- 2025-11-10: POC kickoff — small embedding workload (in-house dataset). POC ran against hosted API using TLS; acceptable quality but security team flagged network path.
- 2025-12-07: Security follow-up (Fireflies ff_2025-12-07_0114). Halcyon sent requirements matrix: PrivateLink or managed VPC peering, HSM/KMS integration, audit logging to SIEM, retention controls.
- 2026-01-15: Redwood security/product team response: dedicated VPC supported, PrivateLink GA/managed PrivateLink not yet available; roadmap item targeted Q3 2026 for full PrivateLink/endpoint automation.
- 2026-01-22: Halcyon execs indicated they need PrivateLink in production by end of Q1 2026 for regulator audit. They began evaluating competitors with immediate PrivateLink support.
- 2026-02-05: Internal changes at Halcyon — CTO (internal champion) left; procurement paused and budget review started.
- 2026-02-10: Last touchpoint: AE pitched temporary mitigations (hybrid VPC routing + strict egress controls), but security insisted on native PrivateLink. Customer said they accepted a different vendor for immediate compliance.

POC notes and technical details:
- Workload: real-time support-agent + vector search for call transcripts (embeddings). Target p95 latency: <= 200ms for short-turn responses; throughput target 80 req/s sustained during peak.
- Model preference: open models (quantized) + fallback to a larger model for summarization. Customer wanted ability to pin versions and fall back within same private network.
- POC results: model quality OK, token-cost acceptable when using recommended batching. Primary failure mode: network architecture — hosted endpoints traverse public egress path that security will not sign off.

Quotes / customer color:
- "We can't route PCI-adjacent telemetry over the public internet — auditors will flag this." — Halcyon CISO (12/07).
- "If we can't get PrivateLink by our audit date, we'll have to go with a provider who can deliver it now." — Head of Infra (01/22).

Why stalled / lost: short summary:
- Product/roadmap misalignment: Redwood's PrivateLink/managed VPC endpoints feature timing did not match Halcyon's audit window.
- Org disruption: internal champion (CTO) left in Jan 2026, slowing decisions and pushing procurement into freeze.
- Budget timing: Q1 2026 budget freeze tightened alternatives evaluation.
- Competitor motion: other vendors marketed immediate PrivateLink + migration support and were perceived lower risk for audit timeline.

Open artifacts / compliance items delivered:
- Security FAQ + network diagram shared (drive link).
- Proposal v3 (pricing + dedicated capacity) shared 2025-12-20.
- Two support tickets opened for architecture clarifications (RED-1329, RED-1410).

Recommended next steps (internal):
- Mark as stalled/lost-to-competitor in CRM; capture lessons re: PrivateLink timing.
- Keep on watchlist: re-engage 30 days after Redwood PrivateLink GA or when Halcyon lifts budget freeze.
- Add to product-priority list: call out audit-driven customers needing PrivateLink sooner; link to this account notes for prioritization.

Short-term follow-up for AE:
- Do not pursue active demos. Send quarterly roadmap bulletin. Check back after Redwood announces PrivateLink GA.

Status tag (informal): "stalled — lost to competitor for PrivateLink timing; re-open if compliance window changes or champion returns."
